svg.title: Orion Mesh
svg.desc: Two Raspberry Pis on NixOS, joined by a BATMAN-adv mesh, measure how much an H.264 stream on the same Wi-Fi channel delays 50 Hz ROS 2 control messages. Both SD images build from one flake. Pictures: Both boards in the KiCad PCB editor, with the bat0 mesh link drawn between their radios.

text.tspan: Two Raspberry Pis on NixOS, joined by a BATMAN-adv mesh, measure how much an H.264 stream on the same Wi-Fi
channel delays 50 Hz ROS 2 control messages. Both SD images build from one flake.
